title: 2026 National DDFS Type-level Risk-set: Apartment Subscription Demand and First Follow-up Reappearance
description: Type-level research dataset for 184 South Korean apartment housing types with initial general-supply first-priority competition of at least 6.0x across 52 projects with a verified first follow-up supply event in 2026. It links initial competition depth, type supply share, pricing and financing covariates to whether the identical official housing type reappeared in the first follow-up supply. The dataset measures type reappearance, not cancellation rate, contract failure rate, winner abandonment, or individual loan availability.
